verdict.rationale: LocalAI is built API-first: the OpenAI-compatible API, model gallery installs (via /models/apply, PRELOAD_MODELS, CLI 'models list'), and agent/MCP configuration (metadata.mcp_servers) are all documented as API/CLI-accessible, suggesting most UI actions map to API calls. However, there's no published OpenAPI spec (probe shows 404s) to verify full parity, and UI-specific conveniences like message 'Edit' correction or the Discover page browsing are not explicitly confirmed to have API equivalents. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/API reference confirming full endpoint coverage, and explicit API equivalents for UI-only actions like edit/discover.
